t: User-friendly, hybrid polymer formulation for the ultimate in bonding and sealing. An alternative to mastics, wood and PU adhesives, silicones, acrylics and butyl rubber sealants. Contains no solvents so will never crack or shrink. Can be applied on wet surfaces, and is paintable. Very high bond strength with resistance to fungal and bacterial growth. Excellent anti-pick properties make it ideal for use in locations where vandalism may occur.
b: Apply in Wet or Dry Conditions
